description: Collaboration Agreement for the University of Jaffna to join the Project for Global Health Research Group on Violence against Women and Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Project of the Global Health Research Group on Violence against Women and Children is implemented with a financial assistance of Rs.173.92 million from the National Institute for Health and Care Research of the United Kingdom. A Collaboration Agreement is to be signed between the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka and 11 foreign institutions including the University of Birmingham of the United Kingdom to implement the said project. The project will integrate sustainable and better-trained Survivor Panels (Community Engagement and Involvement Groups) into the local health system. It is expected through the project to strengthen the response to violence against women and children, assess the health issues associated with violence against women and children, evaluate its economic and social impacts, identify effective prevention and intervention strategies, and facilitate knowledge exchange and capacity building among institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, for the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka to sign the Collaboration Agreement with other relevant parties for the implementation of the said project for a period of 04 years, was approved by the Cabinet.
